part: ME6211 C-series 3.3 V LDO with CE, SOT-23-5
notes: The '-N' suffix of the MPN does not appear in datasheet V14 (selection guide lists ME6211C33M5G); its meaning is unknown.
Repo datasheets/SOURCES.md points me6211.pdf at a different LCSC number (C235316, ME6211C33R5G), not C82942.

ratings.design: VSYS: <= 5.45 V steady with USB; hot-plug peak about 5.7 V (with R47)
PWR_EN: steady <= ~5.0 V with VSYS >= ~4.85 V (OK); hot-plug transient up to ~6.1 V vs VSYS possibly lagging (UNVERIFIED)
3.3 V; note 3V3 can be back-driven (probe/USB) while VSYS is low

ratings.limit: 600 mA abs max; 500 mA max (C33, VIN = VOUT+1)

ratings.design: (VSYS-3.3)*I3V3: at VSYS 5.2 V (USB in) this caps I3V3 at about 158 mA; 3V3 budget UNKNOWN

pins.requirement: Power input; CIN 1 uF in the application circuit.
pins.cite: p4 Pin Assignment (ME6211CXXG SOT23-5); p2 Fig2

pins.requirement: ON/OFF control, active high: VCEH >= 1.0 V start-up, VCEL <= 0.5 V shut-down (C33). Abs max VSS-0.3..VIN+0.3. Datasheet does not say whether CE has an internal pull; treat as must-drive.
pins.cite: p4; p8 ME6211C33 table; p5 Abs Max
pins.quote: CE "High" Voltage VCEH Start up 1.0 V ... CE "Low" Voltage VCEL Shut down 0.5 V
pins.issue: CE abs max is VIN+0.3 V (VIN = VSYS) but PWR_EN is fed from VBUS through R14/D3 (divider with R15: PWR_EN ~ 0.909*(VBUS - Vf)). Steady state OK (VBUS 5.5 V: PWR_EN <= 5.0 V vs VSYS >= ~4.85 V -> limit >= 5.15 V). At hot plug PWR_EN can reach ~6.1 V while VSYS lags behind R47/D5 into C9 (peak 5.7 V -> limit 6.0 V), and with a cell present Q2 may hold VSYS near VBAT for the first microseconds: CE may exceed VIN+0.3 transiently. Current is limited by R14 10k. Open question: needs a scope of PWR_EN minus VSYS at a live plug-in.
pins.resolution: fixed: C47 (100 nF on PWR_EN) slows its rise from VBUS to about 1 ms, so CE cannot lead VSYS at a live plug-in; scope PWR_EN minus VSYS at bring-up (step 5)

pins.requirement: Output; CL 1 uF in the application circuit.
